# The `slidecraft` module

What a vault component may import from `slidecraft` (API version 1). Besides it, vault code may import only `react`, `react/jsx-runtime`, `motion/react` and files in its own folder.

## Defining a component

- `defineComponent`: function

- `ComponentDefinition`: type
- `RegistryConfig`: type
- `RegistryProp`: type
- `ToolbarPropEditor`: type
- `WithChildren`: type
